review.why: Looks up papers, citations, open-access PDFs and records across 18 scholarly APIs, with the provenance to repeat each search.
review.summary: Routes a request to the right scholarly databases, reads a per-database reference first, and makes bounded, rate-limited calls with curl and four helper scripts for pagination, full-text XML, arXiv and abstracts. It warns that these APIs fail with HTTP 200, counts before paging, and returns results with endpoints, parameters, access date and warnings.
strengths: Lists the silent-failure traps of each API and checks the body, not the status
Count reconciliation for exhaustive searches; never presents metadata as full text
Keys are optional, never echoed, and only four named variables are read from a .env
cautions: Scholarly focus: PubMed, preprints and citation data, not business sources
Eighteen reference files and four scripts are described, not read here
Ends with a request to cite the library's own paper in outputs
